thread:
maria: quick thought — need to choose session affinity model for streaming retries. options: sticky-edge vs resume-token. pros/cons?
liam: sticky-edge simplest, lowest latency. cons: edge restarts, cross-region failover, and uneven load.
zoe: resume-token survives failover but requires durable KV or token-encoded state, more complexity.
maria: tokens also force thinking about partial-response idempotency. if a retry replays last N tokens we must dedupe at model layer.
ben: hybrid idea: prefer sticky-edge for the common case, but on disconnect or edge topology change, issue resume-token and failover to it.
liam: hybrid ok, but how do we bound token storage? can't keep everything forever — need eviction & TTL.
zoe: sketch proposal: tokens are short-lived (default 5m), checkpoint every N chunks (configurable). store token -> (shard, offset, checksum) in local edge cache; backfill to control plane only for long sessions.
maria: propose token format: base64(HMAC(shard|offset|sessionid|expiry)) with shard hint appended in plaintext so edge can resolve locally without CP lookup.
liam: header names we should standardize: `X-Resume-Token`, `X-Resume-Offset`, `X-Session-Id`. also use `X-Idempotency-Key` for application-level retries.
zoe: pseudo code for token creation:
```
# token creation (pseudo)
payload = f"{shard}:{offset}:{expiry}"
token_mac = hmac(secret, payload)
token = base64(token_mac) + ":" + shard
```
This keeps the shard hint quick to parse and verifies integrity.
infra-bot: deploy note — token parsing on the hot path adds ~50ns in our bench, acceptable. infra: need optional longer persistence for enterprise tenants.
maria: security notes — encrypt/HMAC tokens, rotate keys per region, avoid embedding any PII. TTL configurable per tenant.
ben: ops concerns — how to surface token eviction to clients? suggestion: on resume attempt if token expired return `410 Resume Token Expired` with hint to restart session.
liam: perf tweak — embed shard hint plus a small cache-key prefix so we avoid hash sharding hot spots. microbench shows 2-3% CPU saving.
zoe: also think about billing and tracing: make resume events emit a `resume_reason` tag (failover, restart, reconnect) so we can quantify frequency.
maria: ok action items: zoe write TTL + LRU eviction RFC, liam prototype shard-hinted token parsing and bench, ben coordinate infra storage and quota impacts. I'll schedule a follow-up after prototypes. :rocket:
